name: utmost-insurance-brokers
description: Utmost Insurance Brokers — the public website (studio/) and the backend that runs the business (ERP/): one repository, one database.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix ERP install && npm --prefix studio install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix ERP run lint && npm --prefix studio run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix ERP test && npm --prefix studio test
scripts.build: npm --prefix ERP run build && npm --prefix studio run build
